He was the one guy that was forced onto Mike Brown's staff (Doug was a player development coach under Alvin Gentry). The Kings aren't even ready to tank. They have too big of a salary commitment and unmovable contracts, so they can't trade for bad contracts and stock up on picks. Hell, next year they might actually get some good play too since most of the vets will be on a contract year and will be trying to get one last payday. After next year is when they will be in position to tank, but by then, the NBA will basically remove any advantage of that strategy. So basically, the Kings will continue to make the 7 - 11 picks in the NBA draft.
